units.source_text: 难怪你怀恨，但务请忘记令人讨厌之事。

en.t: It is no wonder that you bear resentment, but please do try to forget these unpleasant matters.

units.source_text: 卿正斋戒，恐不宜阅读此信。

en.t: Since you are now observing ritual abstinence, I fear it may not be proper for you to read this letter.

units.source_text: 我值居丧，亦未便多通音问。”

en.t: As I am in mourning myself, it is also not convenient for me to exchange many messages.”
